properties.NAME: Oconee Dist.
properties.CHANGE: Oconee District created from Pickens District with same boundaries as OCONEE County. Between 1 Jan 1800 and 16 Apr 1868, judicial districts were the principal admin. subdivisions of the state, while counties survived mostly as geographical references.
properties.CITATION: (S.C. Acts 1868, spec. sess., pp. 28-29; S.C. Acts 1875, res. no. 26, p. 1015; Swindler, 8:497)
